name: Atrium building / 01
description: Three retained furnished floors within a coordinated stone-and-charcoal exterior: private bathroom/service façades, solid wing roofs, a glazed atrium, CEO and boardroom balconies, and a landscaped level entrance. Rooftop equipment and connected ceiling air paths are conceptual reservations; detailed engineering and fire systems remain future work. Exit signage follows the supplied Rev E01 schedule, with optional candidate routes to an assumed public-way connection.
